# 3 Boys and a Dog

> > A practical resource for busy families offering homeschooling guidance, homemaking tips, family recipes, and seasonal activity ideas.

3 Boys and a Dog is a lifestyle blog created by Kelli that focuses on helping busy families balance homeschooling, homemaking, and creating memorable experiences together. The site features practical tips, printable resources, kid-friendly recipes, and seasonal ideas designed for families managing multiple children.

## Key Topics

- homeschooling tips
- homemaking advice
- family recipes
- printable worksheets
- Easter ideas
- kid-friendly lunch
- family activities
- busy families
- seasonal crafts
- healthy snacks
- Easter basket ideas
- lunch ideas
- email newsletter
- guest post policy

## Core Content

- [Homeschooling & Homemaking Tips for Busy Folks - 3 Boys and a Dog](https://3boysandadog.com): Homepage with homeschooling tips, recipes, freebies, and family activities

## Reader Engagement & Contact

- [Contact Me - 3 Boys and a Dog](https://3boysandadog.com/contact-me-2): Contact form for reader inquiries, newsletter signup, and guest post requests
